name: Fujiwara no Ietaka
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 98); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1237.

poems.title: The twilight dim, the gentle breeze
poems.author: Fujiwara no Ietaka
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 98
poems.text:
The twilight dim, the gentle breeze
By Nara’s little stream,
The splash of worshippers who wash
Before the shrine, all seem
A perfect summer’s dream.

poems.title: 98. 風そよぐ 楢の小川の 夕ぐれは (Kaze soyogu Nara no ogawa no yugure wa)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Ietaka
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 新勅撰集
poems.text:
風そよぐ 楢の小川の 夕ぐれは
みそぎぞ夏の しるしなりける
